summary.en: Integrated vision understanding models into a QA system with image-text retrieval and explainable responses.
summary.zh: 把视觉理解模型接入问答系统，支持图文检索与智能解释。

impact.en: Served 5 internal teams and improved issue triage efficiency by about 35%.
impact.zh: 服务内部 5 个团队，平均问题定位效率提升约 35%。

summary.en: Packaged parameter-efficient fine-tuning workflows with unified training, evaluation, and export.
summary.zh: 封装参数高效微调流程，统一训练、评估和导出。

impact.en: Reduced per-experiment cost by around 40% and improved script reuse.
impact.zh: 单次实验成本下降约 40%，训练脚本复用率明显提升。

summary.en: Built a cross-modal retrieval demo with bidirectional image-text matching and visual explanations.
summary.zh: 实现跨模态检索 Demo，支持图文双向匹配与可视化解释。

impact.en: Used for external showcases and PoC, helping to kick off multimodal initiatives.
impact.zh: 用于对外展示与 PoC，帮助推进多模态项目立项。
